name: Zhanlan Laolong
source:
Our protagonist Ren and his friends are onboard a high speed rail train, which is a tourist attraction that goes through the belly of the sea. What they do not know is that once upon a time, the train is a vehicle for time travel experience.
The joyful journey quickly spirals out of control when the train derails, locking everyone in the moment of the bloody incident that endlessly repeats itself.
Ren happens to be the only person that remembers each and every fateful loop. But what’s even stranger — with each repeating loop, one more of his classmates dies before the train’s derailing moment. A mysterious murderer has appeared, and in the name of deliverance hunts down and kills Ren and his friends......

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479500/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角吾時與朋友們登上了一列高速觀光列車，穿行於海底。他們並不知道，這列車曾經是用來體驗時間旅行的交通工具。
列車突然脫軌，歡樂的旅程迅速失控。所有人都被困在血腥事故發生的那一刻，不斷重演。
吾時恰好是唯一能記住每一次命運輪迴的人。但更詭異的是，每重複一次輪迴，就會多一位同學在列車脫軌前死去。一名神秘兇手出現了，打著救贖的旗號，追殺吾時與他的朋友們……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479500/]Steam[/url]]
